ItemID: unavailable; Title: Every Great Motown Hit Remastered; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic soul appeals to me, but I would pass on a hits collection this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Best of Four Tops: 20th Century Masters The Millennium Collection; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This fits my interest in soulful music, but it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Let Me Get By; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Tedeschi Trucks Band's bluesy guitar and soulful sound fit my recent Clapton and Hendrix listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 24K Magic; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in rootsy guitar music than polished pop funk right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Don Henley Cass County; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country direction interests me given my listening to Blown Away, but I would save it for later.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Forever Man; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Enjoying Old Sock makes another Clapton release an easy choice, though I would prefer unfamiliar material.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: In The Lonely Hour; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Contemporary pop ballads are not what I am looking for in this visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Vogues: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Vocal oldies feel less relevant to my current interest in blues and roots rock.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Traveller; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The soulful country sound appeals to me, but I would stick with my two stronger choices today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: From A Room: Volume 1; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its rootsy country style sounds promising, but I am not choosing another album this time.
